description: An extension mod for the Electroblob's Wizardry Minecraft 1.12.2 mod

block: A Sage Tome only opens for a true sage
Can research Stone Tablets and Spell Books
This darkish metal block seems to suppress any forms of magic when stepped on
This devoritium gilded stone block seems to suppress any forms of magic when stepped on
Throw it at an entity or a block\nCan teleport to the bolt with the Master Bolt spell
You can recreate ancient spells at the Scribing Desk with the help of a researched Stone Tablet if the tablet contains a spell
item: A collection of magical practices about elemental manipulation. Grants +10%% bonus spell potency for Fire, Ice and Lightning spells
Active Ability: Shaking the orb releases a cataclysmic earthquake
An Astral Diamond can be charged with the Essence Extraction Ancient spell, by destroying an Imbuement Altar
Beware! The cursed pendant has drawn the attention of an evil wizard
Buff Metamagic spell effects are one level higher with their initial cast
Can be brewed into healing potions with water bottles or into regeneration potions if brewed from healing potions. Applying it on iron ingots transmutes the metal to Gold.
Casting Horse Whistle while riding a horse causes a short gallop
Failed to cast the scroll, try again elsewhere
Grants +10%% spell potency for all spells, but increases mana costs by 10%%
Grants a 25%% chance to activate Cryostasis when critically wounded
Grants a 25%% chance to trigger a Speed buff when being hurt (grants weakness).
Grants a 50%% chance to be immune to poisoning.
Grants a Wizard Shield effect when you are hurt (3 minutes cooldown)
Grants immunity to all Curse Spells.
Greatly increases the chance of ruined spell books to match the element of the dusts used, if 4 matching dusts are used during imbuement
Increases Earth spell Potency by %1$s%%, reduces other element's spell Potency by 50%%
Increases the duration of Buff spells by 20%%
Lunar Flax can only be harvested during midnight, with shears, otherwise the plant is wasted when harvested. It conceals itself during the daylight.
No wizard has answered your request for trading. Perhaps try later or elsewhere
Occassionally grows some Healing Mushrooms near you when you are injured
Raising this magnet causes anyone nearby to receive Magical Exhaustion for a few seconds
Reduces the damage of Mana Vortex to greatly empower its explosion
Requires a matching set of battlemage armor\nSneak-right click it in the mainhand to open its GUI to place charms
Seems to have a rune carved into it
Slowly repairs and imbues your wizard robes with mana while they are in the magical pocket of Attire Alteration
Smashing the ground with Stone Fist creates a small earthquake
Spring Charge creates a lightning pulse on the ground
The Experiment sage spell has +2%% higher chance to result in a Theory Point
The Pendant of Eternity will recast a chosen Buff spell forever if you have a wand on your hotbar with the spell bound to it.
The burrow spell can dig through stone
The scroll created a signal beacon of light, a wandering wizard might notice it soon...

This golden inlaid magical cube holds powerful teleportation magic
Recharges over time in the Charm slot
Using the cube blinks the player
Sneak-cast to phase step
This magically enchanted bucket refills itself with coal daily
This ornate scroll holder can hold a Wand Upgrade Scroll which affects all of your spell casts (Right-click to open)
This scroll can create a magical beacon which will attract wandering wizards who can trade with you
This scroll only works if you can see the sky
This sword refuses to be unsheathed by anyone, but it comes for your aid when in the greatest trouble
Throwing this crystal into a Transportation Portal changes its location to a random, far-away location\nSingle Use
Transmutating spells always results in the same element as the spell being transmuted
While wearing this, there is a chance every midnight that an evil class wizard ambushes you
With this lucky item in your pocket, you have 5%% chance to find an additional artefact in Shrine chests
You search through the bucket but it was empty..
Your Time Knot loop resets immediately if you die while wearing this amulet. This effect has a 5 minute cooldown
